title: Reviewer submission
description: What a reviewer hands to `cq findings add`. cq adds the source (reviewer, model, family) and the revision itself, so a reviewer cannot misreport them. Unknown fields are refused.

scope.description: full: the whole change, base to head. fix_diff: only the commits since reviewed_from.

reviewed_from.description: fix_diff only: the commit the fix diff starts at.

files_reviewed.description: Every changed file you read. With files_skipped it must cover every changed file.

not_fixed.description: Ids, from the list in your brief, of findings that are marked fixed and are not fixed. cq reopens them.

findings.description: An empty array is a valid result. Do not invent findings.

severity.description: BLOCKER: wrong behaviour, data loss or a security hole. MAJOR: an edge-case defect, or real maintainability or test debt. MINOR: small clarity or consistency issue. NIT: taste.

always_blocking.description: Set only when the finding is one of these four. It then blocks at every tier.

claim.description: What is wrong, in one or two sentences.

scenario.description: The concrete input or sequence that triggers the failure, or the named standard it breaks.

confidence.description: Orders the work queue. It never changes a verdict.
